title: Brave Search Scraper
description: Search Brave for ranked web results with titles, snippets, source domains, and links. Submit multiple queries in one run to compare independent search results or track page visibility.

batch.title: Search queries
batch.description: Brave search phrases. Add one object per phrase.
batch.valueDescription: query used to run this search.

schema.description: Language filter. Accepts english/deutsch/... or ISO codes such as en, de. Default: all.
Set to true to include the raw Brave HTML in the response. Default: false.
Alias for query. Prefer query for new integrations.

organic_results.title: Heat Island Cooling Strategies
organic_results.snippet: Trees, reflective surfaces, and green roofs can help lower urban temperatures.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Brave by keyword for ranked links, snippets, domains, and source labels. Compare independent results and track page visibility across queries.
storeCopy.intro: Collect Brave result positions, links, snippets, redirect links, and displayed domains for a batch of phrases. Optional language and HTML inputs refine collection.
useCases: SEO teams can compare Brave result positions and snippets across queries.
Editorial teams can gather publisher links for a topic.
Search analysts can monitor page visibility on Brave.
howToUse: Add one phrase to `queries` for each search.
Choose a language or request HTML when needed.
Run the Actor and export result rows from the dataset.

faqs.question: Is raw result HTML included by default?
faqs.answer: No. Set `include_html` to true only when your workflow needs the source HTML response.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Brave search-result rank for the page, starting at 1.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Page title displayed by Brave Search.

fields.name: link
fields.description: Destination page URL for the Brave result.

fields.name: redirect_link
fields.description: Source redirect URL supplied for the result link.

fields.name: displayed_link
fields.description: Shortened host or address shown in the Brave result.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: Text excerpt Brave Search displays for the page.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Publisher or website label attached to the result.

fields.name: input_query
fields.description: Search phrase submitted to Brave for this result set.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when these Brave search results were collected.
